page.layout: One printed page, text only. Full-width ornamental border at top; heading block centred below it; body text in one column with a woodcut initial; no margin notes; signature word "Erudiens" at lower right of the text block.

main_text.head: LECTORI Cum dignissima honoris præfatione PACEM, IN QVA VNIVERSA. Viderant illi qui recte utuntur oculis,
LECTOR GRATIOSISSIME AC BENEVOLENTISSIME.
main_text.p: VÆ emolumenta redundarent Musarum doctorum Cultoribus ex penitiori Auctorum notitia, ideoque non una ex plaga stimulus mihi subditus, ederem ad hanc rem aliquid locupletius, & ederem sane seporatim. Morem gessi, ut nostrum est, qui non gloriæ nostræ, quod T. Livio improperat Plinius, sed commodis aliorum quærimus, nec Scriptorum tantum lucubrantium, verùm & Virorum, qui argumentum sunt scribendi, EPONYMOLOGIVM, sub quotidiana lectione, quasi obiter, collegimus CRITICVM.

Neq; majestatem magnorum Iædi Principum existimavimus, ceterorum intermistos esse turbæ, tanquam stellulas, quandoquidem Regum sapientes, qui veri Reges, lararis suis doctos non exclauserunt, sed fasces eorum foribus submiserunt, eorum, inter flammas & depræda-tiones, ædibus ac museis pepercerunt, plura semper se debere literatis, quàm sibi debere ultrò professi.

page.notes: Woodcut initial "D" at the start of the first paragraph; the woodcut ornament border at top is not text. Several words are blurred or uneven in the scan (e.g. "Vae emolumenta", "lararis", "Iædi", "plura semper"), so some letters are uncertain and may be misread; the printed line "Erudiens" appears as "Erudiet" in the scan and is uncertain. The top-right marginal pencil mark "2n (1)" is handwriting and is omitted.
